saw_lines: Nobody buys a diamond ring on a whim. Buyers check reviews, compare price, and ask about shipping before they pay.
So the sale is lost in the first line, before the buyer sees the reviews, the shipping terms or the price.
Your site shows 5,500+ reviews and 550+ reviews, yet none of your 13 ads uses either. Put 5,500+ reviews on the creative and open 2 ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 5,500+ reviews and 550+ reviews, yet none of your 13 ads uses either. Ring buyers want proof before they click. Put 5,500+ reviews on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 10 copy ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Lead new buyer ads with free shipping in the first line, then answer the delivery question in line two.
Your median ad runs 156 words and the longest 167, so the buyer leaves before reaching the offer. Cut each ad to two lines of copy, then add the free shipping offer right after them.

Your 10 copy ads open with 6 different stories, and the biggest leads only 2. Spreading ads across 6 openings means no single story gets tested. Build the next batch from the ring and pendant stories, changing only the opening line.
